docs.title: Israeli Digital Humanities Index Schema
docs.text:
A LinkML schema for an index of Digital Humanities (DH) research in Israel. Entities and properties reuse established vocabularies (FOAF, schema.org, Dublin Core Terms, BIBO, DCAT, EDM, SKOS, CERIF); DH projects are classified with TaDiRAH 2.0 research-activity concepts (dynamic enum over the full taxonomy). Free text supports English, Hebrew and Arabic. All entities are identified by IDHI URNs (idhi::); external PIDs are supplementary.

URI: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi

Name: idhi

docs.title: idhi
docs.text:
A LinkML schema for an index of Digital Humanities (DH) research in Israel. Entities and properties reuse established vocabularies (FOAF, schema.org, Dublin Core Terms, BIBO, DCAT, EDM, SKOS, CERIF); DH projects are classified with TaDiRAH 2.0 research-activity concepts (dynamic enum over the full taxonomy). Free text supports English, Hebrew and Arabic. All entities are identified by IDHI URNs (idhi::); external PIDs are supplementary.

URI: https://idhi.co.il/linkml/idhi

docs.title: Slot: additional_urls
docs.text: Further relevant web pages beyond the homepage (blog, social-media profile, registry entry, press coverage...). For records describing the same entity in other systems use same_as instead.

docs.title: Slot: address
docs.text: Postal address, multilingual.

docs.title: Slot: affiliation_role
docs.text: The person's position at the organization (their job/status, not their project role). Use EMPLOYEE when no finer value fits; AFFILIATE is for formal association without employment.

docs.title: Slot: affiliations
docs.text: The person's institutional affiliations, as reified Affiliation objects (organization + position + dates). Use for employment or formal membership, NOT for project involvement — that goes in project_participations.

docs.title: Slot: author
docs.text: The contributing person (by IDHI URN).

docs.title: Slot: author_order
docs.text: Position in the byline; 1 = first author.

docs.title: Slot: authorship_role
docs.text: The kind of contribution. AUTHOR is the default for byline authors; use EDITOR/TRANSLATOR for edited volumes and translations; CONTRIBUTOR for named non-byline contributions.

docs.title: Slot: authorships
docs.text: The person's publication contributions, as reified Authorship objects carrying byline order and role.

docs.title: Slot: begin_date
docs.text: Start of the time span. A string (not date) on purpose: historical periods need values like "-0100" or "circa 1500". Prefer ISO 8601 / EDTF where possible.

docs.title: Slot: catalogs
docs.text: All Catalog records in the index.

docs.title: Slot: code_repository
docs.text: Source-code repository URL (GitHub, GitLab...), if open.

docs.title: Slot: contact_email
docs.text: A published contact address for the entity (office, team or service-desk mailbox). For a person's own addresses use 'emails'.

docs.title: Slot: datasets
docs.text: The datasets this catalog aggregates (by id).

docs.title: Slot: date_issued
docs.text: Formal publication date (or year-01-01 if only the year is known).

docs.title: Slot: description
docs.text: Multilingual free-text description (a few sentences aimed at index visitors, not internal notes).

docs.title: Slot: digital_humanities_activities
docs.text: Digital-humanities research activities practiced in this project, tool or service, as TaDiRAH 2.0 concepts. Prefer the most specific applicable concept (e.g. tadirah:topicModeling rather than tadirah:analyzing); multiple values are expected. This is the primary DH-facet for discovery.

docs.title: Slot: distribution_url
docs.text: Direct download or access URL for the dataset.

docs.title: Slot: documentation_url
docs.text: User or developer documentation for the tool or service (manual, wiki, API reference).

docs.title: Slot: doi
docs.text: The publication's DOI, as CURIE (DOI:10.1234/abcd) or full URL. A supplementary external identifier — the record's primary id is always the IDHI URN. Record whenever one exists; it is the preferred dedup key.

docs.title: Slot: emails
docs.text: Contact email addresses (zero or more). Only record addresses the person has agreed to publish in the index.

docs.title: Slot: end_date
docs.text: End of the event, relationship or time period. Omit for ongoing relationships and open-ended periods.

docs.title: Slot: event_type
docs.text: The kind of scholarly event.

docs.title: Slot: events
docs.text: All Event records in the index.

docs.title: Slot: facilities
docs.text: All Facility records in the index.

docs.title: Slot: facility
docs.text: The facility side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).

docs.title: Slot: facility_affiliations
docs.text: The organization(s) hosting or owning this facility, as reified FacilityAffiliation objects with dates.

docs.title: Slot: family_name
docs.text: Family (last) name, in the person's preferred romanization. Explicitly optional — the authoritative multilingual display name lives in 'name'.

docs.title: Slot: funding_amount
docs.text: Total awarded funding, if public, in ILS unless noted in the project description. Omit rather than guess.

docs.title: Slot: given_name
docs.text: Given (first) name, in the person's preferred romanization. Explicitly optional — the authoritative multilingual display name lives in 'name'.

docs.title: Slot: homepage
docs.text: Public landing page of the entity, if one exists.

docs.title: Slot: id
docs.text:
The entity's primary identifier: an IDHI URN of the form

_ idhi::_

e.g. idhi:person:x7k2m9 or idhi:project:a83bq1. Minted by IDHI at record creation and never reused or changed. The class token is the lowercase snake_case class name (Organization subclasses use "organization"); each concrete class enforces its own token via slot_usage. External identifiers (ORCID, ROR, DOI...) are supplementary and go in their dedicated slots — never here.

Preferably a sortable name (e.g. "Smith, John" rather than "John Smith") for people and organizations; for projects, tools and services, use the name the team itself uses.

docs.title: Slot: participation_role
docs.text: The person's function within the project team. Use PRINCIPAL_INVESTIGATOR only for the formally designated PI(s); day-to-day scholarly work is RESEARCHER, software work is DEVELOPER, enrolled students are STUDENT regardless of their task, external mentors are ADVISOR, and CONTRIBUTOR is the fallback for anything else.

docs.title: Slot: persons
docs.text: All Person records in the index.

docs.title: Slot: presented_at
docs.text: Event(s) in the index where this publication was presented (by IDHI URN), e.g. the conference where the paper was given. Distinct from published_in, the container it appeared in.

docs.title: Slot: programming_language
docs.text: Main implementation language(s), comma-free single value preferred.

docs.title: Slot: project
docs.text: The project side of the relationship (by IDHI URN).

docs.title: Slot: project_participations
docs.text: The person's project involvements, as reified ProjectParticipation objects carrying the role (PI, developer...) and dates.

docs.title: Slot: project_period
docs.text: The project's OWN runtime (when the research is/was conducted). Do not confuse with studied_periods.

docs.title: Slot: projects
docs.text: All Project records in the index.

docs.title: Slot: provider
docs.text: The organization formally responsible for delivering the service (the one you'd contact or contract with) — set this even when the service is listed under a Facility.

docs.title: Slot: publication
docs.text: The publication contributed to (by IDHI URN).

docs.title: Slot: publication_type
docs.text: The kind of publication, as a COAR resource-type concept (journal article, book part, conference paper, thesis...). Pick the most specific applicable concept.

docs.title: Slot: publications
docs.text: All Publication records in the index.

docs.title: Slot: published_in
docs.text: Name of the journal, book or proceedings the publication appeared in, as free multilingual text. If the container work has its own IDHI record or external URI, also link it via part_of.

docs.title: Slot: publisher
docs.text: The organization publishing the catalog, dataset or publication (by IDHI URN).

docs.title: Slot: research_disciplines
docs.text: Humanities discipline(s) of the project (history, linguistics, archaeology...). Free multilingual text for now; a controlled SKOS scheme is a planned upgrade.

docs.title: Slot: ror
docs.text: The organization's ROR ID, as CURIE (ROR:04aj4c181) or full URL. A supplementary external identifier — the record's primary id is always the IDHI URN. Record it whenever the organization is registered in ROR — most universities and research institutes are.

docs.title: Slot: same_as
docs.text: URIs of records in OTHER systems describing the same real-world entity (Wikidata, PeriodO, GeoNames...). Use for linked-data alignment, not for the entity's own pages (use homepage).

docs.title: Slot: service_type
docs.text: The kind of service offered (digitization, consulting...).

docs.title: Slot: services
docs.text: All Service records in the index.

docs.title: Slot: services_offered
docs.text: Services this facility offers to researchers. Reference Service records by id; the Service's own 'provider' may still point at the parent Organization.

docs.title: Slot: start_date
docs.text: Start of the event or of a relationship's validity (e.g. when a person joined a project or organization).

docs.title: Slot: studied_periods
docs.text: Historical period(s) the project studies (e.g. Ottoman period), as TimePeriod records — distinct from project_period.

docs.title: Slot: studied_places
docs.text: Geographic focus of the research (places studied), as Location records — distinct from where the project team sits.

docs.title: Slot: themes
docs.text: Thematic keywords for the catalog/dataset, multilingual.

docs.title: Slot: time_periods
docs.text: All TimePeriod records in the index.

docs.title: Slot: tool_type
docs.text: The delivery form of the tool (web app, library, CLI...). Pick the single value describing how users primarily consume it.

docs.title: Slot: tools
docs.text: All Tool records in the index.

docs.title: Slot: tools_provided
docs.text: Tools this facility maintains or gives access to (by id). Use for hosted instances and lab-maintained software, not for every tool staff members happen to use.

docs.title: Slot: value
docs.text: The text itself, in the language given by 'language'.
